patterns: APPSC asks single facts: MPI (2010) replaced HPI; GDI/GEM indicate gender inequality; National MPI estimated by NITI Aayog (G2 2025).
Global MPI 2018 data recur in APPSC G2: 271 million out of poverty (2005-06 to 2015-16), Bihar poorest state.
Other PSCs test year of introduction (HPI 1997, GII HDR 2010) and MPI dimensions/indicators (standard-of-living indicator odd-one-out).
Statement traps: MPI is not '$1 a day'; National MPI does use Alkire-Foster; MPI = headcount x intensity (not sum); rural decline larger than urban.
App covers these well but adds deeper NITI 2023/2024 figure-heavy statements than PYQs show.
